# Public VeraCrypt header fixtures

These are synthetic headers, not user evidence or mountable private volumes.
Hashcat v8.0.0 ST_HASH/ST_PASS examples are redistributed under Hashcat's MIT license; see each origin in manifest.json and the bundled Hashcat license.
512-byte fixtures contain no data area. layout.hc is a synthetic offset layout.
Public passwords and the intentionally non-secret keyfile are documented in manifest.json.
Python cryptography/OpenSSL AES-XTS generated the PIM/keyfile samples independently of the Rust verifier.
